svg.title: Nguyễn Hà Nguyên's Contribution City
svg.desc: Contribution city: a 3D skyline with one building per day of the last year, taller and brighter for busier days. 3,170 contributions over 306 active days, busiest day November 15 with 100.

g.text: one building per day · taller and brighter on busier days
